name: yt-music-capture
title: YT Music Capture
description: Save a YouTube music video as a tagged m4a with cover art in your music library.
author: allmight97

commands.name: capture-song
commands.title: Capture Song
commands.subtitle: YouTube
commands.description: Download a YouTube music video's audio with cover art and tags, then file it.

commands.name: show-capture-results
commands.title: Show Capture Results
commands.subtitle: YouTube
commands.description: Shows finished captures. The capture worker runs it when a song is done.

preferences.name: musicLibrary
preferences.title: Music Library
preferences.description: Your music folder, on this Mac or on a network share. Artist folders are made here. A network share is remounted automatically once it has been mounted while the form was open.

preferences.name: captureFolder
preferences.title: Capture Folder
preferences.description: Folder inside the Music Library for the capture-folder destinations.

preferences.name: layout
preferences.title: Default Destination
preferences.description: Used when a channel has no remembered destination. Change it per song in the form or its ⌘K menu.

preferences.name: addToMusic
preferences.title: Add to Apple Music
preferences.description: Off by default. When on, each song is also copied into Music's "Automatically Add to Music" folder.
preferences.label: Add to Apple Music

preferences.name: cookiesFromBrowser
preferences.title: Use Cookies from Browser
preferences.description: Pass a signed-in browser's cookies for age-restricted or bot-checked videos.
